## How to start

1. Click on a **Open in Colab** badge below (a free Google account is needed).
2. In Colab: *Runtime → Run all*. The first cell installs Cheetah (~30 s).
3. Fill in the cells marked **✏️ Exercise** (look for `...` and `# TODO`).
4. Stuck? Open the solution notebook.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Save your work
Colab notebooks opened from GitHub are temporary. Use *File → Save a copy in Drive* to keep your answers.
:::

## Run locally instead

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hayg25/ML4Accelerators.git
cd ML4Accelerators
pip install -r requirements.txt
jupyter lab notebooks/
```
